text:
Jordan Lee: hey team, new hire here. need Vault read + a KMS test key for onboarding tasks (sandbox DB and demo webhook signing). who should i ask and what's the fastest flow?
Priya Kapoor: welcome Jordan! :tada: short flow: 1) submit https://redwood.internal/onboarding/secrets (team=infra) 2) include your manager approval in the ticket 3) DevEx grants `secrets-readers` for read paths; write/KMS require eng-security review
Jordan Lee: thanks — whats the standard TTLs? i don't want long-lived creds for demos.
Priya Kapoor: use dev-sandbox creds (4h) or CLI leases (1h-24h). production/service keys rotate every 90 days by default. if you need longer, add justification in ticket.
Priya Kapoor: example fetch command: `vault kv get -field=password secret/team/infra/demo-db`
DevEx Bot: Hi Jordan — workflow created. Steps: submit form, attach manager approval, wait ~1 business day for eng-security. For KMS add a short justification (e.g., "demo webhook signing only"). Avoid committing plaintext keys. Links: https://redwood.internal/docs/secrets/onboarding and https://redwood.internal/docs/secrets/rotation
Jordan Lee: submitted ticket SEC-4890, requested sandbox creds first. posting link here for tracking.
